comments.text: Lines 5-7: MODE 7, ON ERROR RUN, and `*FX200,2`, which makes BREAK clear memory.

Line 100: @%=0, paged mode off and CLS (VDU 15,12); a yellow box (PROCbox) round `4MAT Educational Software` and `C R Y S T A L     U T I L I T Y` in double height, blue on yellow, rows 4 and 5; a second box over rows 10-22, whose inside, columns 2-36 of rows 12-21, becomes the text window. A% non-zero (set by line 250 after a worksheet is printed) skips the printer question and goes straight to the choice of worksheet; the menu chains this program with A% FALSE, so a player coming from the menu is always asked.
Line 115: `A printer is essential if you wish to print worksheets.` and `Do you have a printer attached?`, asked with INPUT until the answer begins with Y or N, either case.
Line 125, N: `Program ended.` and `< S >`; the space bar CHAINs the menu, UNEM.

Line 200: the worksheets, `1. Crystal Log`, `2. Crystal Notes`, `3. Forest Grid` and `4. Finish`, asked with INPUT until the answer is 1-4; 4 restores the whole screen as the window (VDU 26) and CHAINs the menu.
Line 203: `Is your printer ready?` until the answer begins with Y or N; N sets A%=0 and RUNs the program again, back to the printer question.

Lines 210-230: the whole screen as the window, cleared; then, in a REPEAT that line 250 closes, VDU 2 (everything printed goes to the printer too) and MODE 0, eighty columns, and the worksheet chosen: PROClog, PROCnotes or PROCgrid.

Lines 245-250: VDU 3 (the printer off) and MODE 7, then `Another copy (Y/N)?` with INPUT until Y or N; Y prints the same worksheet again from line 210's REPEAT, N sets A%=1 and RUNs the program, which line 100 sends straight back to the choice of worksheet.

PROClog, lines 1000-1030, the Crystal Log: `CRYSTAL  LOG` underlined, then `Name:` and `Date:` lines to fill in, `Other info.:` and three more ruled lines, then a table with columns `LOCATION` and `NOTES` and ten ruled rows for the player's journey, then PROCfeed(19), blank lines to the end of the sheet.

PROCnotes, lines 2000-2040, the Crystal Notes: `CRYSTAL  NOTES` underlined, `Name:` and `Location:` lines, then a table with columns `OPTION` and `RESULT` and ten ruled rows, for writing down what each choice at a place led to; then PROCfeed(23).

PROCgrid, lines 3000-3040, Grubble's Gum Forest Grid: `GRUBBLE'S GUM FOREST GRID` underlined, `North` at the top, then eight columns by seven rows of squares, each four lines tall with its last line ruled, the rows numbered 6 down to 0 on the left and the columns 0 to 7 under them. These are the forest's own coordinates in part 1, where the location screen gives the distance in squares from the west edge (0-7) and from the south edge (0-6); then `NOTES`, `Name:` and PROCfeed(27).
PROClinea, line 7000: a ruled line of 59 underscores, indented 11 columns.
PROClineb, line 8000: one row of the two-column tables, `|`, 19 underscores, `|`, 39 underscores and `|`, indented 10 columns.
PROCup, line 9000: the sides of the two-column tables, `|`, 19 spaces, `|`, 39 spaces and `|`, the blank line above each ruled row.
PROCfeed(I), line 10000: I empty lines, to bring the paper to the start of the next sheet.

PROCbox(a,b,x,ln), lines 11040-11060: a box of yellow teletext graphics (&93) from row a to row b, its left edge at column x and its inside ln wide: graphics characters <, l, - and . at the corners, rows of commas (a thin line) along the top and bottom, and the sides 5 and j with white text (&87) between them, TAB(ln) clearing the inside as in the menu's PROCB.
